newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Feb car sales fall 22 pct yr/yr - Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Thai Feb car sales fall 22 pct yr/yr - Toyota.

text.p: Sales of cars and commercial vehicles in Thailand dipped by 22 percent in February to 38,719 units from 49,503 in the same month last year, Toyota Motors (Thailand) said on Thursday.
"The overall car market is showing a gloomy outlook because of intensifying compeitition and changes in consumer behavior," Toyota said in a statement.
Cumulative vehicle sales in the first two months dropped 8.1 percent to 81,694 from 88,872 in the year-ago period, it said.
Toyota Motor Corp was the top seller of vehicles in February with a 34 percent market share on sales totalling 13,167, down from 14,614 in the same month last year, it added.
Isuzu Motors Ltd was second with 6,070 in February, representing 15.7 percent market share, compared with 10,372 in the same month a year ago.
Toyota passenger-car sales in the month rose 27.1 percent to 6,674 from 5,251 a year earlier. It was the top passenger-car seller with 46.1 percent share in the month.
Honda Motor Co Ltd was second with 2,784 passenger cars sold in February, or 19.2 percent share of the market, compared to 2,921 in the same month the previous year, it said.
